reply.text:
I'm not going to build that one. Burning 1500 calories a day on top of an 800-calorie diet is a big hole to dig, and I won't set a plan around it. That's too little fuel for that much work, and a calorie target or diet isn't something I hand out in prose anyway.

Here's what I can do. The app can work out safe calorie and macro targets for fat loss from your own height, weight and activity, and I can build you a training block that fits the days and time you have. A steady mix of lifting and cardio you can recover from will get you further than a daily burn number.

Want me to set up the targets, build the program, or both? If it's a program, tell me how many days a week and how long per session.
